pages.name: Spin
pages.overview: Spin focuses on outranging your enemies while also taking care of your rage bar, as your moveset uses it the most.

moves.name: Harnessing The Spin
moves.does: The player charges up a spin ball. This is a held move and once used for the first time will show a green meter next to the player until they use an ability that is not an M1. When the player would use a move that is not Q or M1, they will use up all the charge and empower that ability’s damage by a percentage that depends on the meter’s fullness. If it was maximum, the damage would be increased twofold. This move burns the meter at 1 meter per percentage and burns it fast.

moves.name: Rush Attack
moves.does: Five hit strings combo that ends in knockback.

moves.name: Off-Mode Barrage
moves.does: Rapid flurry that pushes the opponent back.

moves.name: On-Mode Heavy Strike
moves.does: Slow, powerful hit with a long wind-up.

moves.name: Lesson Two
moves.does: The player swings forward a punch, if landed, the enemy will be knocked back. This can lead to combo extend with projectiles. Has armor. Get Off me tool

moves.name: Focused Energy
moves.does: The player  punches forward with both fists. If this were to connect to an enemy, the enemy will spin on themselves and then be ragdolled.

moves.name: Curved Shot
moves.does: The player throws a curved steel ball that tracks to the nearest opponent, dealing damage if lands and stunning very little. This move only has a 6 second cooldown. The animator should make two different animations, one where they shoot left and one where they shoot right. If the first cast of this move was left shot, then the other will be a right shot

moves.name: Focused Energy
moves.does: The player throws a steel ball forward that comes back to them. If on the way back this ball would hurt an opponent, that opponent will be launched into the player, where the player will land a Spin infused punch, ragdolling.Of course, it can also hit enemies when thrown, but won't come back to the user and as such will not do the grab part.

moves.name: Overflowing Energy
moves.does: The player throws a steel ball projectile with weight that when it sticks to a surface will explode into a tornado, sending anyone inside of it upwards while ragdolling them. If the player goes inside, they will be lifted up.

moves.name: The Golden Ratio
moves.does: The player crouches as they hold their hand out to harness energy from the ground, where a golden ratio is drawn, if uninterrupted, they will be rewarded with 50 meter

moves.name: Medicinal Function
moves.does: This move is a holdable move. The player puts their hands on their arm and channels spin energy, Healing them at a rate of 1 HP per 2 Meter rapidly.

pages.name: Mandom
pages.quote: Welcome to the true man's world.
pages.overview: Mandom focuses on punishing your enemies from afar and using your utility to mess with your enemy.

moves.name: True Man's World
moves.does: The player plays with their watch, after a short startup, everyone in a timestop radius will go back to their previous place,state, and hp 6 seconds ago, all enemies will be stunned for 3 seconds.

moves.name: Rush Attack
moves.does: The player pulls out their gun and does a combo of pistol whips forward, ending with a short lived shot that deals knockback (the shot is not a projectile and is just a visual).

moves.name: Quickfire
moves.does: The player quickly pulls out their gun and shoots 6 short live projectile rounds, the rounds have enough stun to combo extend. Acts like your barrage

moves.name: Stompdown
moves.does: The player stomps the ground, hitting ragdolled opponents and ragdolling them again (bonus damage move, can also hit awake opponents)

moves.name: Focus Strike
moves.does: The player puts their hand on their holster and focuses for a maximum of 3 seconds (Held move). Once the player lets go, they will fire a quick shot that deals ragdoll however, if it were to interrupt an ability, will stun the opponent, NO MATTER if the move had hyperarmor or not.

moves.name: High Noon
moves.does: The player pulls out their gun and get ready to fire at any moment for as long as they hold this move. Enemies near the player will get a circle that slowly becomes smaller and smaller, ending with a skull if the circle becomes too tiny. Once the player lets go, they will fire a shot at every enemy who has been marked, dealing damage depending on the size of the circle, going from 15 DMG to a maximum of 150 DMG for the skull, deals small stun.

moves.name: Final Showdown
moves.does:
The player stands still and focuses, if hit during this, a cutscene will begin where they dodge the blow by moving their head and then do a liver blow to the enemy, pushing them back. The player will then throw a backup gun to the opponent and they will catch. After this, a minigame will start for both players, 

Here is how it works. Players stand still and wait for one of them to press M1, either player can do this at any time, players can also press M2 as a counter, Once a player press M1, a subtle and quick animation of them pulling out their gun and shooting will appear, giving the time for the other player to counter. If this were to hit a player, then they will be dealt 200 DMG and be dealt ragdoll, however. Dodging can lead to a counter fire, which of course, the player who shot can dodge.

The camera during this part of the cutscene is almost like a 2d view of both players. Animation Wise, this move should be divided into these parts.

1- The counter
2- First Cutscene
3 - Idle during minigame
4- Counter during minigame (By user)
5- Counter during Minigame (By defender)
6 Shooting
7 Being shot

moves.name: Backup
moves.does: The player uses mandom and reverses themselves to the position they were when they used their last move. They will then use that move again. Note that the enemies do not wind back, additionally, you have to use this move in a 10 second time between using the move or you will not be able to wind back

pages.name: Tusk ACT IV
pages.quote: Gyro, for this reason… this was the reason for “lesson 5”. Thank you… Thank you, Gyro. I truly… truly… thank you… I can’t find any other words to express it.
pages.overview: Tusk focuses on hyper rushing down your opponent and not leaving them space. If they ever try getting away from you, you can get them back into your hold by shooting your projectiles towards them.

moves.name: "I Will Call This Tusk"
moves.does: Below your rage bar lies 10 nail pictures. This is a meter used in Tusk's moveset. Nails restore themselves one at a time and do it slowly.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The player attacks 5 times, with the last dealing knockback

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: Tusk attacks 5 times, the last hit ragdolling

moves.name: Furious Strike
moves.does: The Stand barrages forward, ending with a punch that deals knockback.

moves.name: Wormhole Manifestation
moves.does: The player aims and then shoots a nail forward. If this were to hit a player, Tusk will come out and barrage them, ending with a punch that ragdolls. If this hits a surface, it will create a wormhole that tries to move towards the closest enemy, ragdolling them when in contact. The player can freely move and use moves without tusk while Tusk is barraging.

moves.name: Rampaging Destruction
moves.does: Tusk tries grabing forward. If landed, it will choke the enemy, spin on itself and then run the enemy into the pavement. Tusk will then detach itself from the user and glide forward while having the enemy hit the pavement, throwing them away after a short time. The player can freely move and use moves without tusk for the second part of the move.

moves.name: Golden Shot
moves.does: The player charges up a nail and then fires it forward, ragdolling anyone hit to the floor

moves.name: Nail Shot
moves.does: The player shoots a nail forward, Holding this move will fire more nails, skipping the startup

moves.name: Spatial Harassement
moves.does: The player points at the sky and shoots nail up above. The nearest enemy will then have a black cylinder under their feet that gets smaller, Once it becomes small enough, the fired nail will come down, creating a wormhole in the ground where tusk appears to try and punch the enemy through, ragdolling if landed.

moves.name: Looming Destruction
moves.does: Tusk punches forward. If this hits an enemy, the enemy will be Soft Knocked tusk will  come from behind, grabbing their head and throwing them towards the user. During the second part the player can freely move and use moves without tusk.

moves.name: Infinite Rotation
moves.does: Tusk punches the ground beneath the user, creating an AOE that ragdolls. The main purpose of this move is the following. A giant wormhole will then be created where the ground was smashed for 10 seconds that pulls enemies towards it center, slowly damaging them. Can pull in ragdolled enemies and enemies in I-Frames. Does not stun

moves.name: Wormhole Traveling
moves.does: The player shoots nail into their head and then fall into a wormhole. If not cancelled, the player will become a fast moving wormhole that can climb any surface (Can cling to walls). While in the hole, the player can use any moves that can be done with their hand, having the player's hand come out of the hole and do the animation. Pressing H will cancel this move and exit out of the wormhole, Lasts for a max of 6 seconds. Hitting the wormhole will make the player exit.

moves.name: The Final Lesson
moves.does:
The player poses with tusk and then fire a nail forward (Not mouse aimed). If  this hits someone, a cutscene will begin.

The enemy will be flown into the air, where tusk will be summoned and barrage the enemy. Tusk will then punch the enemy even higher into the air. The camera will then go to first person of the enemy, where they will see Tusk flying rapidly towards them in a punch position. Once close enough, tusk will punch downward, sending the enemy into the pavement.

If this was to kill, the following happens

Tusk comes down from the air and starts barraging the enemy, ending with a final punch. that kills the enemy and shatters the ground in a wide area. The player will then start to cry, only to see their roblox friend in the sky (Make them transparent), letting out a final goodbye.

moves.name: Lesson V
moves.does: Tusk glides forward, if it meets with an enemy, tusk will grab the enemy, send them into the sky, teleport above and barrage them from above, ragdolling the enemy after. During the second part, the player can freely move and use moves without tusk

moves.name: Moveres Crus
moves.does: The player puts their hand on the ground and then use the power of spin to propel themselves toward their cursor's position

moves.name: Herbal Tea
moves.does: The player pulls out a cup of tea and drinks it, restoring 3 Nails, this move has a very low cooldown.

blocks.text: Talk To Gyro with a Steel Ball equipped.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I saw you using this and it was spinning so fast, how did you do that?

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: [Laughing] Nyo-Ho. It's a technique called SPIN. It uses the natural geometry of the world The Golden Ratio to create infinite rotation.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: WOW… I need you to teach me this technique.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Really, huh. Everyone wants to throw iron around until they realize how heavy it is.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But I'm serious! I’ll do whatever it takes to learn spin.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Is that so? If you’re serious you have to prove it then, go find my teddy bear for me, I really miss it and I can’t sleep without it :( .

blocks.text: Quest (1) Added - Find Gyro lost Teddy Bear
Quest (1) Finished Go back to Gyro

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I brought you your lost teddy bear you asked for, now what?

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Alright. You proved you can follow the instructions, however this is the start now comes the hard part.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Lesson One. Spin isn't raw strength, Spin is a supernatural rotational energy that enhances the destructive power of an object. What I want you to do is to feel this supernatural energy through your body.

lines.speaker: 8sw23ne
lines.text:
Take 1500 Damage
Deal 2000 Damage

blocks.text: Quest (2) Finished - Go talk with Gyro

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: You made it back. You’ve got the basics down, now what I want you to do is to train your body and reflexes. Take it over!

lines.speaker: 8sw23ne
lines.text:
Perfect Block 15 Times a real player
Dash 30 times

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: You are improving a lot. but human muscle has limits. You have to believe in Spin.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But how?!

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Focus your vision! Close your eyes to the world and let them open for the Golden Ratio.

lines.speaker: 8sw23ne
lines.text: Believe in Spin (An arrow will appear showing you the path to the Golden Ratio, stand near the marked objects for 5secs for it to count) (total of 5 objects)

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: You see it now, the golden rectangle isn't something you create, it's everywhere. You just need to match your rotation with it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And what’s the point of that exactly?

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Nature never stops, when you force a spin with just your arm the energy doesn't last and dies in seconds, but when you match your energy with the golden ratio, you are borrowing power from nature.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: All because of the Golden Ratio.

lines.speaker: 8sw23ne
lines.text: To achieve the unlimited power of Golden Spin picture a rectangle and inside it there’s an infinite amount of rectangles and the central spots it forms a spiral which has unlimited power (Draw The Golden Spin, super small mini game like the squid games cookies challenge where you have to follow the lines to finish the cookie same but with the golden spin.)

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So this is it? Have i reached the final lesson

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: No, keep moving forward. The final lesson is waiting for you, however the true rotation isn't just about kinetic energy or muscle, it's about what's in the heart.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An animation will then play of a flag being warped into reality and taking away gyro. Until the player enters a new server, gyro will not be there anymore

lines.speaker: 8sw23ne
lines.text: it's truly a detour (A bar will appear that fills up the closer you are to valentine and goes down the further you are. This is not the one we already have, instead, this npc can spawn anywhere in TLA city. Killing the boss will finish the quest)

blocks.text: Once completed, the quest will finish and grant the manual

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You: I couldn't have done it without Gyro. Thank you for teaching me. Thank you for everything, Arigato Gyro.

keywords.text: Knockback that leads to a combo
